title: The Weekly Challenge - 401
task1_desc: You are given a string representing an expression of fraction addition and substraction. Write a script that returns the calculation result of given expression in string format. If final result is an integer, change it to the format of fraction that has a denominator 1.
task2_desc: You are given a string containing an out-of-order English representation of digits 0-9. Write a script to return the digits in ascending order.
